## What happened?

Describe the expected and observed behavior. Use fictional examples only.

## Environment

Agent name/version, installation method, operating system. No tokens or absolute personal paths.

## Minimal reproduction

List the smallest steps. Do not attach raw session logs or customer information.

## Verification

State what was executed and what remains unverified.
